decision.title: Evaluator follow-ups: calls, paths, coercion, namespaces (packet 1.18b)

body.p: . Gaps reported by 1.20 and 1.21; sections are those of the XPath 4.0 editor's draft of 13 October 2026 (vendored with QT4).

item.p: Dynamic calls (4.6.3.1): the target is coerced to function(*)* (a JNode gives its jvalue); one function is called as before (tail calls kept), none gives (), several go through , a resumable body of the evaluator's own (not a library row) that calls each in turn and concatenates. A dynamic partial application (4.6.4) lowers to a MAP over the target whose body is fn:partial-apply on the focus (golden hof-920 of changed).

Paths (4.7.3, 4.7.5): maps and arrays on the left of / and // and as the origin of a step become JNode roots as if by fn:jtree. The error codes stay XPTY0019 and XPTY0020 (); the draft's XPTY0004 (PR 2627) and its selector interpretation of non-navigational steps are not done.

Coercion (3.4.2) runs on an explicit stack of s: choices and unions take the first alternative an item matches, else try each in order and keep the first attempt's error; typed arrays, maps and records are coerced part by part (records built with sxml_record_make; surplus keys and keys equal after coercion are XPTY0004); a JNode that does not match is coerced through its jvalue; the whole implicit-casting table applies when the required type is the "to" type exactly (so no xs:anyURI to xs:NCName); an enumeration accepts an xs:anyURI by its string; function coercion wraps even an instance of the type, except an item whose signature is that type. A value that matches a type whose matching items never change is returned after one match; an integer range is matched in O(1) (xs:integer a subtype of the item type).

fn:replace: $replacement has its F&O 4.0 type again, (xs:string | fn(xs:untypedAtomic, map((xs:integer | xs:string), xs:untypedAtomic)) as item()?)?; the function gets untyped values (integer group keys only: the regex seed has no named groups), coerced by the call; 's coercion in the body is gone.

Lowering: a parameter whose default the body supplies, left out before a keyword argument, gets () when its type allows it: every such default in F&O 4.0 is () or default-on-empty (section 1.5), except $timezone of adjust-*-to-timezone, a last parameter. Otherwise still UNSUPPORTED_FEATURE.

Static namespaces: a unit keeps the statically known namespaces beyond the predeclared ones (sxml_ir_unit_set_static_namespaces, _get_static_namespaces; collected by sxml_xpath_collect_namespaces: the expression's declarations, then the configuration's); CAST, CASTABLE and xs: constructor calls pass them to the cast. xs:QName#1 as a function item still sees the predeclared prefixes only.
array:index-of calls fn:deep-equal's body once per member (a leaf).
number(xs:integer(...)) eq integer is false by design: comparisons are decimal-exact since PR 2218 (QT4 fn-numberintg1args-2a); the cases that expect true depend on XP20 to XP31 only.
